# Code review: entitlements endpoint (`482232a4...e3a1ca7b`)

**Mode:** committed range only (`482232a4...HEAD`). I ran the checks by hand without the paired-agent adjudication step, so **this report has no score**.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Verdict** | Ready to open the PR. Nothing blocks it. |
| **Score** | None. The skill's rule is to give no score when no finding went through paired-agent adjudication, and the 2-subagent limit meant none could. |
| **What to fix first** | Nothing is required. Four small (P3) items are listed below. |
| **Size** | 25 files, +1812 −60 · base `482232a4` → head `e3a1ca7b2`. Only the committed range was reviewed. The untracked `.claude/skills/code-conventions/` folder was not. |
| **Repo** | safe-client-gateway · TypeScript/NestJS/Fastify · vitest · biome and tsc gates · 10 non-negotiables (AGENTS.md) plus the `docs/agents/*` guides · all 9 areas have code to check |

## Results by area

| Area | Result | Who checked it |
|---|---|---|
| Testing | 2 × P3 | subagent |
| KISS | 1 × P3 | me |
| Conventions | 1 × P3 | me |
| Security | clean | subagent |
| Bugs | clean (1 low-confidence observation below) | subagent |
| Regression | clean | subagent |
| Architecture | clean | me |
| Performance | clean | me |
| DRY | clean | me |

## What this review did not cover
- **No paired-agent adjudication.** The 2 subagents went to the category passes (security+bugs, testing+regression). I did the other five passes myself and checked every finding against the code myself, not with a separate validator and refuter.
- **Nothing was run.** No tests, lint or tsc, as you asked.
- **"Since your last run" is skipped.** The `last-run.tsv` in the shared git directory belongs to a different PR (safes v2), so there is nothing to compare against. I also did not overwrite it.

## Must fix before opening
None.

## Worth a ticket or a quick fix (all P3)

| ID | Location | Finding | Fix |
|---|---|---|---|
| TST-001 | `src/app.module.ts:125` | The `billingService && users` gate on `EntitlementsRoutesModule` is the stated reason the module was split out (`entitlements-routes.module.ts:8-17`). No test covers the two flags having different values, so changing `&&` to `\|\|` would leave CI green. | Add a controller-spec case that boots with `billingService: true, users: false` and asserts the route returns 404. |
| TST-002 | `src/modules/entitlements/domain/entitlements.rules.ts:85` (also `:108`) | `freePeriod > 0` creates a boundary at `0`, which the Zod schema allows. The specs only use `30` and `null`, so what `0` should mean is never pinned. | Add a `freePeriod: 0` case each for `eventPeriodStart` and `resetsAt`. |
| KIS-001 | `src/modules/entitlements/routes/entitlements.service.ts:481-494` | `toEntitlementsResponse` copies `ResolvedEntitlements` field for field. The `plan` mapping is already built at `:102-108`, and the DTO classes already `implements` the resolved types. | Return `resolveEntitlements(...)` directly, or map `plan` in one place only. |
| CNV-001 | `src/modules/entitlements/domain/entitlements-repository.module.ts:27` | `SpaceSeatSelection` is dropped from `forFeature`, and with `autoLoadEntities: true` the app no longer registers it. But `space-seat-selection.entity.db.ts` and `domain/entities/space-seat-selection.entity.ts` stay as orphans, and the ORM CLI still picks them up via `orm.config.ts:8`. The change is also unrelated to the endpoint. | Either delete both entity files, or keep the registration and do the cleanup in its own PR. |

## Not sure about these
- **BUG-001** (confidence 35, below the 40 floor), `src/modules/entitlements/domain/entitlements.rules.ts:82` and `:105`
  - **The issue:** `if (cycle?.currentPeriodStart)` treats an active, paid subscription whose `currentPeriodStart` is null (the upstream schema allows null) the same as the Free tier.
  - **Effect:** usage would be bucketed from the space's creation date instead of the billing cycle.
  - **Why it's unconfirmed:** the only seeded feature, `safe_seats`, is stock-metered and returns before reaching this line. It only matters once an event-metered feature is seeded.

## Ruled out
- **Seed and enum drift.** `FEATURE_KEYS` is an OpenAPI enum while `FeatureKey = string`. It's documented at `src/modules/entitlements/domain/entities/feature.entity.ts:5-9`, and `entitlements.service.integration.spec.ts:462-466` checks that the seeded keys match `FEATURE_KEYS`.
- **Missing `CONCURRENTLY` in the index migration** (`migrations/1787213793533-add-space-safes-space-id-index.ts:18`). None of the repo's 15 `CREATE INDEX` migrations use it, so this follows the existing pattern.

## Checked and clean
- **Auth:** `AuthGuard` is at `src/modules/entitlements/routes/entitlements.controller.ts:49`. The user id comes from the JWT, and `assertMember` requires an ACTIVE membership at `src/modules/entitlements/routes/entitlements.service.ts:118-119`. Tests cover 401, 403 and 400.
- **Input validation:** the path param goes through `SpaceIdPipe`, the same pipe other space-scoped controllers use.
- **Queries:** all built with TypeORM `where` objects and scoped to the space.
- **Migrations:** the seed is idempotent, and its `down` deletes dependent rows before the `features` row, matching the `RESTRICT` foreign keys.
- **Regression:** the interface changes only add methods. The one `new EntitlementsService(` call in the specs matches the new constructor. The `subscription-sync` spec rewrite drops no assertions.
- **Architecture and performance:** each layer calls the one below it. The other module is only reached through `ISpaceSafesRepository`. Reads run in parallel with `Promise.all`, and the count uses the new `IDX_SS_space_id` index.

## Worth tidying
No separate proposals. CNV-001 is the only cleanup worth doing, and it's already listed above.

## How this was produced
- **Scope:** git diff of the range above.
- **Subagents (2):** security+bugs, and testing+regression.
- **By me:** architecture, performance, DRY, KISS and conventions.
- **Counts:** 5 findings raised · 4 kept as P3 · 1 below the confidence floor · 2 ruled out.
- **Nothing changed:** no files modified, nothing posted.
